confirmation_policy: No holdout or candidate selection: all historical Train outcomes are known and results are descriptive; do not tune or extend the fixed trial after seeing results.

trials.comparison: one fixed event-state configuration; BO vs prior-20-session Donchian; MR episode p and net expectancy vs analytical driftless p0

feature_definitions: Split-safe raw OHLC. Initial box uses the prior 20 sessions, prior-only ATR20, width 0.5–3.0 ATR, and current close inside fixed prior boundaries. Subsequent state transitions are EXTEND -> ANCHOR -> BOX after one ATR reversal. Invalid or missing OHLC resets the state and history; no imputation.
model: Deterministic per-security event state machine; no fitted model.
selection_rule: No model selection. Continue MR only if pooled post-cost episode expectancy and p-p0 are positive, the date-clustered 95% interval for p-p0 is above zero, and the effect is not isolated to one entry year. Compare BO separately with the fixed Donchian reference. Do not integrate if either leg fails.
